title: The gated delta rule
brief: Implement the recurrence two ways and prove the chunked form matches the sequential one.
hints: Work in float32 throughout. The state is an accumulator.
Compute cumulative decays in log space: g_t / g_j is exp(log g_t - log g_j).
A[t, j] is strictly lower triangular, so (I + A) is unit lower triangular and torch.linalg.solve_triangular applies.
The output at t uses the state after t's own update, not before it.
